title: Understanding Conflict
speaker: Ryushin Kate Korn McKenna and Seishu John Wiley
summary: Here's a summary of the Soto Zen dharma talk in one paragraph: The speaker offers an interest and needs-based model for conflict resolution, which focuses on understanding the underlying needs and interests of all parties involved rather than just asserting one's own needs. This approach aims to create a more relational and compassionate way of managing conflicts, leading to greater intimacy and connection. By recognizing and addressing these underlying issues, individuals can potentially change the course of the conflict and achieve a better outcome, fostering empathy, transparency, and vulnerability in their interactions with others.
